subject: [PATCH v5 03/11] mm, swap: prepare the swap IO path for vswap

2026-09-18.patch_summary: This patch prepares the swap IO path for vswap by allowing it to submit IO for a swap entry other than folio->swap. It achieves this by computing the sector from an explicit entry, which is then used in various functions such as swap_add_folio and __swap_writeout. This change enables the batching path to serve both vswap entries and physical entries mapped directly into PTEs. The patch also updates ops->can_merge to measure sectors and byte offsets from the batch head plus accumulated length instead of from the previous folio plus its size.
